55.
The  Central  Bank  shall  create  and  administer  a
currency stock in order to ensure the availability of a regular
supply of currency notes and coins.

56.
Any  person  who  without  the  authority  of  the
Governing  Board–

(a)
cuts,  perforates,  or  in  any  other  way  whatsoever
mutilates any currency note;

(b)
prints, stamps, or draws anything upon any currency
note, or affixes any seal or stamp to or upon any
currency  note;

(c)
attaches  or  affixes  to  or  upon  any  currency  note
anything in the nature or form of an advertisement;

(d)
reproduces  in  any  form  whatsoever,  or  makes  a
facsimile of, any currency note; or

(e)
uses otherwise as a legal tender, any currency note,
commits an offence.
